component_findings.manifest_constraints: Preserved paid evidence (ecosystem-tooling--part-1--zig): Zig places in the 41-60 band (scored 47): the official zig fetch/build.zig.zon system provides a real manifest, exact-hash reproducibility and a principled MVS-like resolution algorithm with a stable/unstable dependency-graph safety rule, but it deliberately has no central registry, no override mechanism for patching transitive dependencies, and no enforced governance over package name/identity, pushing all availability, mirroring, takedown and abuse-handling responsibility onto whichever third-party source host (mainly GitHub) each dependency URL happens to point at.
